newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate easing slightly.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate easing slightly.

text.p: The Italian money market expects overnight rates to ease slightly to 7.39 percent over the next month from an actual rate of 7.44 percent this week, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed on Friday.
This is lower than the 7.52 percent overnight rate forecast a week ago, according to the study which is based on implicit rates and uses the actual rates registered on Thursday.
On a three month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.3 percent, higher than the 7.19 percent projected a week ago and 6.97 percent expected one month ago.
On a one year horizion the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.19 percent, up from 6.82 percent a week ago and 6.39 percent projected a month ago.
Over two years the overnight rate is forecast at 7.39 percent, little changed from last week's expectation of 7.32 percent and 6.62 percent forecast one month ago.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate two years hence and the implicit German overnight rate over the same time frame is considered a good indicator of market confidence in the prospects for Europe's economic and monetary union.
This spread was seen shrinking to 252 basis points from 261 a week ago and 223 one month ago.
